narrAffiliate.name: California Consortium of Addiction Programs and Professionals (CCAPP)

narrNote: CCAPP appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22), and CCAPP's own site describes its Recovery Residences arm as California's only NARR affiliate, certifying recovery residences to NARR standards. Certification is voluntary: California does not license sober living homes or require NARR/CCAPP certification to operate.
notes: California's SUD system is county-administered: DHCS is the Single State Agency (per SAMHSA's SSA directory), but treatment access runs through each county's behavioral health / alcohol and other drug program, so the countyDirectory entry is the practical front door. Medicaid SUD coverage is Drug Medi-Cal; most counties deliver it through the Drug Medi-Cal Organized Delivery System (DMC-ODS), a county opt-in organized delivery system operating under CalAIM 1915(b)/1115 authority (current demonstration authority runs through Dec 31, 2026), with remaining counties on traditional Drug Medi-Cal. The statewide DHCS automated SUD Non-Emergency Treatment Referral Line (800-879-2772, English/Spanish) routes callers to their county office. Largest county system: Los Angeles County Dept. of Public Health, Substance Abuse Prevention and Control (SAPC), whose Substance Abuse Service Helpline (SASH, 844-804-7500) is the 24/7 screening/referral entry for LA County's DMC-ODS network. State peer-run crisis support: CalHOPE Warm Line (833-317-4673), a DHCS program. Every URL in this file was fetched and content-checked on 2026-10-22.
